mapper.sql: SELECT m.improvement_id, m.kind, m.round_id, m.team_code, m.assignee_id, m.inspection_result, m.detail, m.improvement_plan, m.planned_date, m.action_result, m.action_status, m.closed_yn, m.closed_by, m.closed_at, m.close_comment, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_by, m.updated_at, r.round_year, r.quarter, t.team_name, u.user_name AS assignee_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence e WHERE e.owner_type = 'IMPROVEMENT' AND e.owner_id = m.improvement_id AND e.deleted_yn = 'N') AS evidence_count FROM improvement m JOIN audit_round r ON r.round_id = m.round_id LEFT JOIN team t ON t.team_code = m.team_code LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = m.assignee_id
mapper.select: WHERE m.improvement_id IN (SELECT x.improvement_id FROM improvement_item x JOIN round_item i ON i.round_item_id = x.round_item_id JOIN checklist_item c ON c.item_id = i.checklist_item_id WHERE c.seq_no = #{seqNo}) ORDER BY r.round_year DESC, r.quarter DESC, m.improvement_id DESC

SELECT x.improvement_id, x.round_item_id, c.seq_no, c.audit_area, c.audit_item, c.item_detail, c.audit_period FROM improvement_item x JOIN round_item i ON i.round_item_id = x.round_item_id JOIN checklist_item c ON c.item_id = i.checklist_item_id WHERE x.improvement_id IN #{id} ORDER BY x.improvement_id, c.seq_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO improvement (kind, round_id, team_code, assignee_id, inspection_result, detail, improvement_plan, planned_date, action_result, action_status, closed_yn, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{kind}, #{roundId}, #{teamCode}, #{assigneeId}, #{inspectionResult}, #{detail}, #{improvementPlan}, #{plannedDate}, #{actionResult}, #{actionStatus}, 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE improvement SET team_code = #{teamCode}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, inspection_result = #{inspectionResult}, detail = #{detail}, improvement_plan = #{improvementPlan}, planned_date = #{plannedDate}, action_result = #{actionResult}, action_status = #{actionStatus}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE improvement_id = #{improvementId}
